Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an interesction with a reported right knee injury. Over the course of care the
patient attended twenty visits. The mechanism of the crash appears consistent with the knee complaints described, and the
presentation is in keeping with the froce involved. Treatment followed a conventional progression, with visit frequency
decreasing as symptoms eased and function returned toward baseline. Imaging performed to date showed no abnormality, and
standard orthopedic examination maneuvers were within normal limits. Most of the reported symptoms are based on the patient's
own descriptions of pain, as objective findings were unremarkable. The patient mentioned a minor strain affecting the same
region several years ago, which had resolved completely without lasting effects. Billing records reflect single entries for each
service with no duplicate charges. Ongoing monitoring and home exercise guidance were provided, with follow-up as needed.
